It is the 8th installment of the Crayon Shin-chan series.  It was released as Shinchan: Bungle in the Jungle in India on April 1, 2011 at theaters, its Indian television premiere was made on May 22, 2011 on Hungama TV and later it was released on DVD in India. Because of this there are some discrepancies between the book and the film.  This book, like the movie and series, is set between Star Wars: Episodes 2 and 3.
